scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run arch:check && npm run actionlint && npm run docs:check && npm test
scripts.build:server: node_modules/.bin/esbuild prod-server.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm '--banner:js=import { createRequire } from "module"; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);' --external:better-sqlite3 '--external:@node-rs/argon2' --outfile=dist/server.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build:web && npm run build:server
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:web && playwright test e2e/playwright/duel.spec.ts
